prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Choose Your Pet Experience", "Select a pre-made pet for instant play or build a custom companion from your photos."]
1: ["Create Account to Save Your Pet", "Sign in first so your desktop pet and settings sync seamlessly across sessions."]
2: ["Your Pet is Being Created!", "Play a quick mini-game while your desktop companion gets ready.", "Pet Playground", "Practice feeding and playing with virtual toys while generation completes."]
3: ["How to Control Your Desktop Pet", "Use Ctrl+Pet to open commands, or right-click the system tray icon to hide or summon your pet anytime.", "Got It, Let's Go!"]
4: ["Signing in backs up your pet traits so you never lose your companion when reopening the desktop app."]
5: ["Pet synthesis typically takes 2-3 minutes. You can minimize this window."]
6: ["Includes Starter Accessory Pack!"]
7: ["We will notify you on your desktop as soon as your pet is ready to join you."]
8: ["Meet Your New Desktop Companion", "Summon Pet to Desktop"]
9: ["Upload Clear Pet Photos", "For best results, upload well-lit photos facing forward without background clutter.", "Supported formats: PNG, JPG under 10MB."]

verdicts.problem: Mentions free extras or bonus packs
